echo_similarity.source: HC3 (training/echo-detection/calibrate_similarity.py, results/echo_similarity.json): thresholds from 500 development questions; on 500 test questions ROC-AUC 0.876, false-positive rate 18.6% at possible and 6.6% at high; worst source wiki_csai: false-positive rate 70% at possible, 36% at high (textbook answers look alike)

delivery.source: hand-set weights and thresholds; no labelled read-vs-spontaneous interview data yet

ai_text.source: levels come from the sidecar (local-ai/integrity/models/echo_tfidf.json), thresholds chosen on HC3 validation questions

reading.source: levels come from the sidecar (local-ai/integrity/models/reading_network.json), thresholds chosen on GazeBase development people
